text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_category_farmDashboard_desc
text.text: Export timing, collectors, and performance budgets for the Farm Dashboard desktop app.

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_enableVehicles_desc
text.text: Export fleet positions and vehicle details.

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_enableFields_desc
text.text: Export field crop, soil, and windrow data.

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_enableFinance_desc
text.text: Export money, loans, and vehicle finance data.

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_enableEconomy_desc
text.text: Export market prices and economy tables.

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_enableStock_desc
text.text: Export silo and storage fill levels.

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_enableBaleInventory_desc
text.text: Export physical bale stock on the map.

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_enableRedTape_desc
text.text: Export Red Tape mod data when installed.

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_collectionCycleSec_desc
text.text: Time between full export cycles. Higher values reduce CPU use.

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_sliceBudgetMs_desc
text.text: Wall-clock budget per collector slice. Lower values reduce stutter.

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_postLoadGraceSec_desc
text.text: Delay after loading a save before collectors start.

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_baleWorldPerFrame_desc
text.text: Loose world bales scanned per frame.

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_jsonKeysPerFrame_desc
text.text: Top-level JSON keys serialized per frame when writing data.json.

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_animalRowsPerSlice_desc
text.text: Animal rows scanned per livestock slice.

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_economyYieldStride_desc
text.text: Rows stepped per economy yield scan.

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_diagnostics_desc
text.text: Log collector timing to log.txt. Trace lines appear only on single-player, host, or dedicated server (not MP clients).

text.name: ui_settings_gameplay_fd_debugBaleScan_desc
text.text: Throttled bale scan lines in log.txt.
